scripts.prepare:web: deno task --config ../../web/deno.json build && deno run -A tools/stage-web.ts
scripts.check:native: bun run prepare:native && bun run test:native-presenter && cd native/openfx-native-photos && perry native validate --no-build && xcrun swiftc -typecheck swift/OpenFXNativeServer.swift -framework AppKit -framework Foundation -framework Network -framework Photos -framework PhotosUI -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers
scripts.check: bun run check:native && bun run check:perry
scripts.compile: bun run prepare:native && perry lock --update openfx-native-photos && perry compile src/main.ts -o dist/OpenFX
scripts.build: bun run prepare:web && bun run check && bun run compile && bun run package:macos
